title: Sustainable development
quote: Use resources today without compromising future generations' ability to meet their needs

boxes.title: Meaning & scope
items: Includes: present needs + equity across generations + "leave no one behind"
Excludes: growth that runs down natural capital
⚠ Political, military, cultural are **not** classic pillars
**National Environment Policy 2006**: conservation and livelihood ==linked, not opposed==

boxes.title: Principles
head: Principle
Meaning
rows: Don't deplete at cost of future
No full certainty ≠ reason to delay prevention

items.what: ==**Rio Earth Summit (UNCED)**==: **Agenda 21**, Rio Declaration (**27 principles**), UNFCCC, CBD

boxes.title: Measures
head: Measure
Meaning
rows: Adds unpaid work; subtracts pollution, crime

boxes.title: Cases & AP
items: ==**Vellore Citizens' Welfare Forum (1996)**==: precautionary + polluter pays in Indian law
India **99th of 167** in SDR 2025 (UN **SDSN**): first time in top 100

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Odd one out as a goal: ==**maximising growth at any cost**==
First Earth Summit = **Rio 1992**; Rio+5 in **New York**
